Nine is giving away four $10,000 Freedom vouchers to viewers who vote in The Block 2026 Room Reveals. Each week the teams hand over a finished room, the judges score it, and you get to pick the couple and the room you rated best. Cast your vote, complete the entry form, and you are in the draw for a share of the $40,000 Freedom furniture prize pool.

**How do you vote on The Block 2026?**

Go to the Youi and Freedom voting page on nine.com.au after each Room Reveal, choose your favourite couple and their renovated room, then fill in the entry form with your full name, suburb and postcode, email address and telephone number. You can vote once per Room Reveal and up to twelve times in total, so a fresh entry opens every week The Block is on air.

**Do you need to watch The Block to enter?**

No. It is a game of chance and skill plays no part in determining the winners, so you do not need to watch the show or pick the room the judges crown. Voting is simply how your entry gets counted. The promotion closes 8 November 2026 and the four winners are drawn at Anisimoff Legal in Melbourne.

**Who can enter the competition?**

The competition is open to permanent residents of Australia aged 18 years and over. Certain individuals, such as directors, management, employees, officers, contractors of the Promoter, the Promotion Sponsor, the Prize Supplier/s, any related corporate bodies, and their immediate families, are not eligible to enter.

**When does the competition close?**

The competition closes on 08/11/26 at 11:59pm AEDT.

**How can one enter the competition?**

To enter, participants must visit the designated online platform during the Promotional Period. They need to vote for their favourite couple and their renovated rooms from the most recent Room Reveal. After voting, they must complete the promotion entry form by providing their full name, suburb and postcode, valid email address, and telephone number. Entrants must agree to the Promotion's terms and conditions before submitting their entry. Each entrant can enter once per Room Reveal, with a maximum of twelve (12) entries allowed during the entire Promotional Period.

**What are the prizes and the total prize pool amount?**

The prizes consist of four (4) $10,000 Freedom vouchers. Each of the first four valid entries drawn will receive one voucher. The total prize pool is valued at AUD $40,000. Winners will be drawn electronically at Anisimoff Legal, Melbourne, in the presence of an independent scrutineer. Winners will be notified by phone and email within two business days of the draw, and their names will be published by 11/11/26.
